message.essentialcraft5.wind_pact.steadf.en: The wind settles around your feet. While you sneak, nothing can push you back.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_pact.steadf.zh: 风绕着你的脚站定了。潜行时，再没有什么能把你推开。

message.essentialcraft5.wind_pact.deflec.en: The wind starts turning things aside for you: what others shoot or throw at you passes straight through, one every few seconds.
message.essentialcraft5.wind_pact.deflec.zh: 风开始替你挡开飞来的东西：别人射来、扔来的会从你身上穿过去，每隔几秒一次。
